probes.relevance_note: Top hit (same paper, Interpretation of Results) does not give a V2V-Intersection-specific SSI+ percentage -- it gives an AGGREGATE 85% SSI+ reduction (39-99% CI, across all crash types) and states both observed SSI+ crashes were of the Secondary Crash type, not V2V Intersection. The semantic probe strengthens this: the paper's Interpretation of Results reports an 85% AGGREGATE Suspected Serious Injury+ reduction (39%-99% CI, across all 11 crash-type groups combined) and states both of the two observed Suspected Serious Injury+ crashes were of the Secondary Crash type -- meaning zero V2V Intersection crashes were observed under this outcome at all, so no V2V-Intersection-specific Suspected Serious Injury+ percentage exists to report, not merely one that was omitted.
